answer.text: HEY holds no published project for that contract. That is a statement about HEY’s index, not about the token; verify_project says what HEY recorded about the contract itself. A published project carries this token’s name or ticker on a different contract: "chit" on 0xd523a627030509021cc39b6d7c8543417d3e50d8 (the same name and ticker; an address ending in the same four characters). On chain a token is its contract, never its name or ticker.

disclaimer.text: Public, source-backed activity HEY recorded. Still Building means verified activity through a tracked market drawdown — it is not a prediction, not a ranking by price, and not investment advice. Few projects meet Still Building or Under the Radar at any time; both are strict by design, and list responses carry the counts.
